mapper.select: SELECT id, process_instance_id, node_id, node_name, node_type, start_time, end_time, duration, operator, comment FROM wf_history_activity WHERE process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} ORDER BY start_time ASC

SELECT id, process_instance_id, node_id, node_name, node_type, start_time, end_time, duration, operator, comment FROM wf_history_activity WHERE process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} AND node_id = #{nodeId} ORDER BY start_time ASC

SELECT id, process_instance_id, node_id, node_name, node_type, start_time, end_time, duration, operator, comment FROM wf_history_activity WHERE process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId} ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ha.id, ha.process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, ha.node_id AS nodeId, ha.node_name AS nodeName, ha.start_time AS ccTime, ha.comment, pi.process_def_id AS processDefId, pi.process_key AS processKey, pi.business_key AS businessKey, pi.start_user AS startUser, pi.start_time AS processStartTime, pi.`status` AS processStatus, pi.app_id AS appId, pd.`name` AS processName, pd.business_type AS businessType, pd.system_form_key AS systemFormKey, pd.business_form_id AS businessFormId FROM wf_history_activity ha INNER JOIN wf_process_instance pi ON ha.process_instance_id = pi.id INNER JOIN wf_process_definition pd ON pi.process_def_id = pd.id WHERE ha.node_type = 'CC' AND ha.comment LIKE CONCAT('%接收人: ', #{ccUser}, '%') ORDER BY ha.start_time DESC

SELECT ha.id, ha.process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, ha.node_id AS nodeId, ha.node_name AS nodeName, ha.start_time AS ccTime, ha.comment, pi.process_def_id AS processDefId, pi.process_key AS processKey, pi.business_key AS businessKey, pi.start_user AS startUser, pi.start_time AS processStartTime, pi.`status` AS processStatus, pi.app_id AS appId, pd.`name` AS processName, pd.business_type AS businessType, pd.system_form_key AS systemFormKey, pd.business_form_id AS businessFormId FROM wf_history_activity ha INNER JOIN wf_process_instance pi ON ha.process_instance_id = pi.id INNER JOIN wf_process_definition pd ON pi.process_def_id = pd.id WHERE ha.node_type = 'CC' AND ha.comment LIKE CONCAT('%接收人: ', #{ccUser}, '%') AND pi.app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY ha.start_time DESC

SELECT ha.id, ha.process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, ha.node_id AS nodeId, ha.node_name AS nodeName, ha.start_time AS ccTime, ha.comment, pi.process_def_id AS processDefId, pi.process_key AS processKey, pi.business_key AS businessKey, pi.start_user AS startUser, pi.start_time AS processStartTime, pi.`status` AS processStatus, pi.app_id AS appId, pd.`name` AS processName, pd.business_type AS businessType, pd.system_form_key AS systemFormKey, pd.business_form_id AS businessFormId FROM wf_history_activity ha INNER JOIN wf_process_instance pi ON ha.process_instance_id = pi.id INNER JOIN wf_process_definition pd ON pi.process_def_id = pd.id WHERE ha.node_type = 'CC' AND ha.comment LIKE CONCAT('%接收人: ', #{ccUser}, '%') AND pi.app_id IS NULL ORDER BY ha.start_time DESC

SELECT ha.id, ha.process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, ha.node_id AS nodeId, ha.node_name AS nodeName, ha.operator, ha.start_time AS startTime, ha.end_time AS endTime, ha.duration, ha.comment, pi.process_def_id AS processDefId, pi.process_key AS processKey, pi.business_key AS businessKey, pi.start_user AS startUser, pi.start_time AS processStartTime, pi.`status` AS processStatus, pd.`name` AS processName, pd.business_type AS businessType, pd.system_form_key AS systemFormKey, pd.business_form_id AS businessFormId, pd.priority FROM wf_history_activity ha INNER JOIN wf_process_instance pi ON ha.process_instance_id = pi.id INNER JOIN wf_process_definition pd ON pi.process_def_id = pd.id WHERE ha.node_type = 'APPROVAL' AND ha.end_time IS NOT NULL AND ha.operator = #{operator} AND (ha.comment IS NULL OR ha.comment NOT LIKE '%审批节点完成%') ORDER BY ha.end_time DESC

SELECT ha.id, ha.process_instance_id AS processInstanceId, ha.node_id AS nodeId, ha.node_name AS nodeName, ha.operator, ha.start_time AS startTime, ha.end_time AS endTime, ha.duration, ha.comment, pi.process_def_id AS processDefId, pi.process_key AS processKey, pi.business_key AS businessKey, pi.start_user AS startUser, pi.start_time AS processStartTime, pi.`status` AS processStatus, pd.`name` AS processName, pd.business_type AS businessType, pd.system_form_key AS systemFormKey, pd.business_form_id AS businessFormId, pd.priority FROM wf_history_activity ha INNER JOIN wf_process_instance pi ON ha.process_instance_id = pi.id INNER JOIN wf_process_definition pd ON pi.process_def_id = pd.id WHERE ha.node_type = 'APPROVAL' AND ha.end_time IS NOT NULL AND ha.operator = #{operator} AND (ha.comment IS NULL OR ha.comment NOT LIKE '%审批节点完成%') AND pi.app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY ha.end_time DESC
